any_one_accident_limit.definition: The maximum amount Underwriters will pay in the aggregate under this Certificate in respect of all Insured Persons suffering Bodily Injury following an Accident in the same Accident or series of Accidents contributed to, caused by, or consequent upon the same original cause, event or circumstance.
any_one_accident_limit.proportional_reduction_rule: In the event of any one incident exceeding this figure, the Underwriters' liability in respect of each Insured Person shall be proportionately reduced until their total liability does not exceed said limit.

war_unrest_disruption.rule: Cover under this Certificate EXCLUDES all travel to areas of War, Unrest or Disruption unless declared and Agreed by Underwriters prior to travelling to such areas.
war_unrest_disruption.business_travel_definition: A Country or region to which the FCDO advise against 'ALL' travel, along with Belarus, Russia, Ukraine, Gaza, Israel & Lebanon.
war_unrest_disruption.holiday_travel_definition: A Country or region to which the FCDO advise against 'ALL' or 'All but Essential' travel (www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice), along with Belarus, Russia, Ukraine, Gaza, Israel & Lebanon.

kidnap_exclusion.rule: Cover EXCLUDES any Kidnap which occurs in the named countries, or any other region/country to which the Insured Person has travelled where the UK FCDO has advised against 'all travel or all travel due to the threat of kidnap' (or similar advice for non-UK-resident Insured Persons) prior to the commencement of the trip.

1.title: Medical Expenses, Repatriation and Emergency Travel Expenses
1.covers: Medical Expenses, Repatriation and Emergency Travel Expenses necessarily incurred following Bodily Injury (Accident) or Illness during an Insured Journey.

extensions.repatriation_of_household_goods_eur: 2,000 (only if the External Journey exceeds six months and the Insured Person dies)

key_exclusions: Medical expenses in the normal country of residence, except the specific limited return-home allowance
Travelling against medical advice, or for the purpose of obtaining treatment/convalescent care
Terminal prognosis cases
War within the Insured Person's own country of residence
War caused by Nuclear, Chemical or Biological cause
Expenses more than 24 months after the Accident/Illness
Repatriation or Search & Rescue expenses incurred without Healix International's prior approval
Dental/optical unless emergency
Suicide or intentional self-harm (except repatriation expenses following suicide)
Travel to areas the FCDO/WHO/local health authority advise against, unless declared and agreed by Underwriters

2.title: Cancellation, Curtailment, Replacement and Change of Itinerary
2.covers: Cancel/curtail/replace/rearrange an Insured Journey, or change a pre-booked itinerary, as a direct and necessary result of a cause outside the Assured's or Insured Person's control.

extensions.travel_delay_inconvenience_benefit: First 8-hour delay: €50, plus €50/completed hour after, max €500/claim on the outward journey at start of the Period of Travel; max €150/claim on subsequent outward journeys.

key_exclusions: Disinclination to travel
The Assured's financial circumstances
Financial failure/neglect of a transport or accommodation provider
Government/public authority regulations
Pre-existing strike/industrial action known before booking
Mechanical breakdown of under 2 hours' delay
Travelling against medical advice or for treatment purposes
No suitable Medical Practitioner evidence provided

3.title: Baggage, Delayed Baggage and Business Equipment
3.automatic_reinstatement: Sum insured is not reduced by a loss during the same Insured Journey; no extra premium for this.
key_exclusions: More than €3,000 for any one item, pair or set
Household effects

Valuables (jewellery, precious metals/stones, furs, watches, binoculars, telescopes, photographic/audio/computer/telecoms/video equipment) lost in Carrier custody, outside the Insured Person's control
Money and Credit Cards (covered instead under Section 4)
Atmospheric/climatic damage, cleaning/dyeing/repairing damage, government confiscation/detention
Mechanical/electrical breakdown
Baggage shipped as freight / under a bill of lading
Valuables/Business Equipment loss not reported to police within 48 hours
Unattended property loss unless in a locked hotel room/safe/apartment/residence/venue showing forced entry, or a locked vehicle glove box/boot showing forced entry
3.condition: The Insured Person must exercise reasonable care in supervising the property at all times.

4.title: Money, Travellers' Cheques, Passports, Travel Documents, Credit Cards and Rental Vehicle Excess
4.passport_replacement: Up to 25% of the sum insured, including reasonable additional travel/accommodation cost to obtain a replacement.
4.business_documents_and_records: Up to 25% of the sum insured, for Business documents/records belonging to or the responsibility of the Assured or Insured Person.

rental_vehicle_excess.covers: The excess/deductible the Assured/Insured Person is legally liable to pay under the Rental Vehicle Agreement, where cover for that loss/theft/damage was in force.
exclusions: Use outside the terms of the Rental Agreement
No optional Rental Vehicle insurance was taken out as part of the Rental Agreement
Damage not proven to have occurred during the Rental Agreement

4.automatic_reinstatement: Sum insured is not reduced by a loss during the same Insured Journey; no extra premium for this.
key_exclusions: Losses over €3,000 in coin/bank/currency notes per person per event
Shortages from error, depreciation, or customs confiscation/detention
Credit card loss where card-issuer terms weren't complied with
Losses not reported to police within 48 hours
Money lost inside Baggage while in Carrier custody, outside the Insured Person's control
4.condition: The Insured Person must exercise reasonable care in supervising the money at all times.

5.title: Personal Accident

special_extensions.coma_benefit: 350 per full week, up to 104 weeks
special_extensions.dependents_benefit: +2% of death benefit per dependent child (up to 18, or 25 if in full-time education)
special_extensions.facial_disfigurement_eur: 1,250 for 1-5cm scarring; over 5cm paid per the compensation scale
special_extensions.fracture_benefit_eur: Up to 1,000/500 per specific fracture type, max 5,000 total per Period of Insurance
special_extensions.ptsd_terrorism: 50% of item 8 rate, max 300/week, max 16 weeks, only if item 8 is insured for that person
special_extensions.visitors_corporate_event_benefit_eur: 25,000 per person for Visitors/Guests injured on Assured's premises or at a Corporate Event

key_exclusions: Suicide, attempted suicide or intentional self-injury
Deliberate exposure to exceptional danger (except saving human life)
Own criminal act
Riding/driving in a race
Armed forces operational duties
Mountaineering/rock-climbing normally requiring ropes or guides
Aerial activities other than as a fare-paying passenger
Radioactive contamination
HIV/AIDS or related illness
Illness/disease, naturally occurring or degenerative conditions, and PTSD/psychological conditions not resulting from Bodily Injury

6.title: Legal Expenses and Personal Liability
6.legal_expenses_notes: Per claim, per Insured Person, for pursuing compensation for the Insured Person's death, Illness or Bodily Injury on a trip. Underwriters appoint the legal representative; a 90-day notification window applies as a condition precedent.
6.personal_liability_notes: For legal liability for Bodily Injury to a third party, or damage to property not belonging to/controlled by the Insured Person or family/household/colleague/employee, caused by an Accident on the trip. 30-day notification condition applies.
key_exclusions: Aircraft, horse-drawn/motorised vehicles, watercraft (other than rowing boats/punts/canoes), animals, firearms, explosives, weapons
Occupation or ownership of land/buildings
Trade, profession or Business activity
Racing of any kind
Deliberate, criminal, malicious or illegal acts
Liability already covered under other similar insurance
Legal proceedings outside constitutional/international/supranational courts other than the European Court of Justice and the Commission and Court of Human Rights

7.title: Hijack, Kidnap and Detention
7.covers: Unlawful seizure of an Insured Person during an Insured Journey: daily benefit, travel/accommodation costs from the seizure, Constellis security-services costs, and PR/legal/medical adviser costs (with Underwriters' knowledge and agreement).
7.mandatory_provider_contact: Constellis must be contacted for any claim to be paid. US: +1 713 918 6401. Rest of World: +44 (0)20 7240 3237.
key_exclusions: Any fraudulent, dishonest or criminal act of the Assured or Insured Person
Constellis-related expenses incurred without Constellis's prior consent
Public relations/legal/medical adviser costs incurred without the Company's prior consent
See the general Kidnap exclusion list under Endorsements for excluded countries

8.title: Evacuation
8.covers: Evacuation Expenses when an Insured Person is forced to Evacuate during an External Journey, for a cause outside the Assured's/Insured Person's control.
8.mandatory_provider_contact: Healix International must be informed immediately of anything that may give rise to a claim. Tel: +44 (0)20 8608 4052.
key_exclusions: Violating local laws/regulations
Missing immigration/work/residence documentation
Redundancy
The Assured's financial circumstances
Evacuating nationals of the country involved, unless ordinarily domiciled elsewhere
Disinclination to continue the journey
Evacuation without Healix International's prior consent

9.title: Personal Security Specialist Expenses
9.covers: Costs of engaging Healix International's security services to extricate an Insured Person from a Life-Threatening Situation.
9.life_threatening_situation_definition: Any situation/event on an Insured Journey where Healix International agree the Insured Person's life is potentially in danger.
key_exclusions: Situation directly due to circumstances within the Assured's/Insured Person's control
Fraudulent, dishonest or criminal acts
Circumstances more specifically covered under Section 7 (Hijack/Kidnap) or Section 8 (Evacuation)

10.title: Guests and Corporate Event Cover
10.covers: Guests of the Assured sustaining Bodily Injury following an Accident while on a Corporate Event.

general_exclusions_all_sections: Suicide, attempted suicide or intentional self-injury
Deliberate exposure to exceptional danger, except saving human life
Non-prescribed drugs not legally obtainable from a pharmacy/dispensary
Mountaineering/rock-climbing normally requiring ropes or guides
Aerial activities other than as a fare-paying passenger
Travel to areas the FCDO/WHO/local health authority advise against all travel
Any Bodily Injury or Illness arising directly or indirectly from a Cyber Act
War within the Insured Person's own country of residence
War occasioned by Nuclear, Chemical or Biological cause
age_limit: No cover attaches, except with Underwriters' specific prior agreement, for any Period of Travel undertaken by an Insured Person aged 81 or more at its commencement.

optional_activity_clauses_status.holiday_inclusion_clause: Not Included on this certificate (per the Schedule of Benefits page).
optional_activity_clauses_status.winter_sports_inclusion_clause: Only available where the Holiday Inclusion Clause applies — currently Not Included, so Winter Sports are not automatically covered either.
optional_activity_clauses_status.scuba_diving_inclusion_clause: Same basis as Winter Sports — tied to the Holiday Inclusion Clause, which is currently Not Included.

claims_process.notify_within: As soon as practicable, max 6 months from the event, to Crawford TPA (or your broker for a death claim).
claims_process.crawford_address: Crawford TPA, Blarenberglaan 3c, Mechelen, Vlaanderen 2800 Belgium
claims_process.fraudulent_claims_clause: A fraudulent claim voids Underwriters' liability for that claim, lets Underwriters recover sums already paid, and lets Underwriters terminate the contract from the time of the fraudulent act, without returning premium. This can apply per-covered-person without affecting cover for others.

cancellation_and_refunds.cancel_by_assured: In writing to the broker, any time.
valid_reasons_for_underwriters_to_cancel: a change in risk Underwriters can no longer cover
non-cooperation or failure to supply requested information
cancellation_and_refunds.refund_outside_cooling_off: Pro-rata refund less a 20% cancellation fee of total incurred premium (minimum €50), provided no claim has been made or is intended.

law_and_jurisdiction: Governed by the laws of England and Wales, exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales, unless specifically agreed otherwise.

healix_travel_oracle_app.note: This is Healix's own app registration code, separate from Certificate No. CGT P804302600.
